{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2, so safe to drop)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(grouped)

# Find the species with the highest mean
max_species = grouped.idxmax()
max_value = grouped.max()

print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {max_species} ({max_value:.2f} mm)")"}
